title: Mega Gardevoir ex 042/063 M1s - Pokemon Mega Symphonia JP - Ultra Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Gardevoir ex 042/063 M1s card is a sought-after Pokémon collectible from the Mega Symphonia set in the Pokémon TCG game. This Double Rare card features a Gardevoir character with a HP of 360, illustrated by Takuyoa. With attributes of Multi-Color, Psychic, and Colorless, this EX speciality card showcases alternative art, full art, and extended art in a holo finish. This Japanese-language card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection for fans and collectors alike.
